purpose: Provisional individual-skill crosswalk for first-mock Physics Mechanics/Materials and taught Chemistry Energetics/Thermodynamics; not entire specification certification.

statusDefinitions.sample: One or more existing mock cards specifically practise this short-recall skill; this does not certify complete question or answer coverage.
statusDefinitions.partial: Related evidence exists, but some part of the requirement still needs a separate card or manual check.
statusDefinitions.unverified: No appropriate flashcard has yet been located in the reviewed source samples; this is not a claim about the entire repository.

notes: AQA 7408 sections 3.4.1.1–3.4.2.2 and 7405 3.1.4 and 3.1.8 reviewed at individual-skill level.
Sample evidence links prove a relevant card exists in the website mock pool, not that every word of the requirement or possible marking paraphrase is certified.
A card can legitimately practise a skill from another AQA subsection; such links are explicitly identified in crossSectionEvidenceIds instead of being silently presented as exact specRef matches.
Unverified means no direct matching card was checked in the seven sampled banks, not that the whole 4,313-card website lacks that skill.
Two incorrect non-existent 3.1.8.3 subsection tags on task1_v298_chemistry_20 and _21 were corrected to official 3.1.8.2.

v310: selective follow-up search of all supplemental banks and historical core deck resolved the eight previously unverified skills into four direct examples and four partial examples; one existing formation/combustion definition entry also became a direct sample.
sourceFileSamplingNotes: Only linked cards from the very large core deck were individually checked. Including deck.json as a source does not mean all its cards have been audited.
